title: Move Media — Website
subtitle: Web Design — Video Production
description: The digital home for Auckland video house Move Media — a dark, cinematic site built to let the footage do the talking. 'We capture what matters,' carried from brand into a full WordPress build.

sections.label: Overview
paragraphs: Move Media is an Auckland boutique corporate-media team — meaningful video and photos, with purpose-led edits, for the moments that matter most to a business. With the brand identity in place, they needed a website that felt as considered as the films they make.

The site leans dark and cinematic so the work stays centre stage. The homepage opens on a single line — We Capture / What Matters — in the brand's teal, then hands straight over to the footage. It's built on WordPress so the team can keep publishing new projects themselves.
This is the website chapter of the wider Move Media identity — the same teal, type and tone, translated into a living, scrollable product.

sections.label: The Site
paragraphs: A short, confident structure — Home, Projects, About, Contact — that gets out of the way of the imagery. Every page is built around full-bleed stills and a calm, dark canvas.
